note: #3402 Fix — mutating routes whose data belongs to the authenticated user, so a role gate would deny them access to their own settings. Reviewed exemptions, not a floor: every entry names a live ungated route and carries its reason.

routes.app/api/tenant/2fa/backup-codes/route.ts: Regenerates the caller's own recovery codes, keyed by ctx.userId; no tenant-wide data.
routes.app/api/tenant/2fa/disable/route.ts: Disables the caller's own TOTP enrolment, keyed by ctx.userId.
routes.app/api/tenant/2fa/setup/route.ts: Starts the caller's own TOTP enrolment; the secret is scoped to ctx.userId.
routes.app/api/tenant/2fa/verify/route.ts: Verifies the caller's own TOTP code before enabling their enrolment.
routes.app/api/tenant/ai-keys/route.ts: Personal AI keys: listProviderKeyMeta/deleteProviderKey are scoped to ctx.tenantId + ctx.userId. Tenant keys live under a different, gated route.
routes.app/api/tenant/dashboard/layout/route.ts: saveLayout is keyed by ctx.tenantId + ctx.userId — the caller's own dashboard tiles.
Writes the caller's tenantMembers.notificationPrefs row, filtered by ctx.userId.
routes.app/api/tenant/notifications/matrix/rout: PATCH updates the caller's own tenantMembers row by ctx.userId; no other member's prefs are reachable.
routes.app/api/tenant/notifications/route.ts: All reads and writes filter notifications by ctx.tenantId + ctx.userId; a role gate would hide a member's own inbox.
routes.app/api/tenant/user/preferences/route.ts: Reads and writes the users row for ctx.userId only, with a concurrency guard on that same id.
